system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Submits application for a new tap water connection.. my household_id is JJM-HH-1000, my aadhaar_number is 100020003000, my village is Sample Village.

function.name: jjm_apply_connection
function.description: Submits application for a new tap water connection. Transitions connection_status to 'applied'. Requires session_token. Infrastructure must be available or under construction in the village. Does NOT install connection. Fails if household already has active connection, duplicate application, or village has no infrastructure.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.
